visual_enhancers.surfaces: White cards on gray surface (#F3F4F6). 1px border-wm-surface-2 with rounded-2xl. Subtle shadows on hover (shadow-[0_10px_15px_-3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]).
visual_enhancers.gradients: bg-gradient-brand (135deg, #2563EB → #00B4FF) for primary CTAs and step icons. bg-gradient-brand-soft available for tinted backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.textures: Decorative blurred blobs (hero-blob utility) — position: absolute, border-radius: 9999px, filter: blur(80px), opacity: 0.5. Used in Hero and ClosingCTA for depth.
visual_enhancers.overlays: No image overlays. Decorative SVG illustrations are pure CSS div mockups (browser window + phone frame).
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-2xl (cards), rounded-xl (buttons/inputs), rounded-full (pills, avatars, primary CTAs).

components.Navbar: Sticky top-0 z-50, white/95 backdrop-blur, border-b border-slate-200/80. Logo (image 36x36) + wordmark 'webmula' with 'mula' in text-wm-primary. Nav links (text-sm font-medium text-slate-600, hover:text-wm-primary). CTA button rounded-full bg-wm-primary.
components.Hero: min-h-[calc(100vh-80px)] white bg, 3 hero-blob decorations (primary/sky/mint). Two-column: left = subtitle + h1 + body + 2 CTAs + 3 feature pills. Right = CSS mockup (browser window + phone frame) with skeleton divs in wm-primary/10 tones.
components.FeatureSection: 4-column card grid (sm:2 lg:4). Card: rounded-2xl border bg-wm-surface/40 → hover:bg-white, -translate-y-1, shadow. Icon: 12x12 rounded-xl bg-wm-primary/10 with inline SVG (stroke=currentColor, text-wm-primary).
components.PricingSection: Section bg-wm-surface. 3 visible packages + 1 centered (md:col-start-2). Card: rounded-2xl border. Featured card: border-2 border-wm-primary with -my-3, z-10, larger shadow, badge 'PALING POPULER' rounded-full absolute -top-3. Price: text-2xl font-extrabold text-wm-primary. Check/Cross inline SVG icons. Expandable feature list with grid-rows transition.
components.Portfolio: 4-column grid (sm:2 lg:4). Card: rounded-2xl border bg-wm-surface, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl. Image aspect 16/9 with group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-500. Category uppercase 12px text-wm-primary. Title text-lg font-semibold. 'Lihat Detail' link with arrow SVG.
components.Process: 5-step horizontal grid (md:grid-cols-5). Connecting line: absolute bg-gradient-brand h-0.5 z-0. Each step: 14x14 circle bg-gradient-brand p-0.5 with white inner + step icon. Card: rounded-2xl border bg-white with title + body.
components.WhyUs: 4-column card grid. Identical card pattern to FeatureSection (rounded-2xl, icon in 12x12 wm-primary/10 tile, title font-bold, body text-sm/70).
components.Testimonials: 3-column on md. Card: rounded-2xl border bg-white p-6. Opening quote SVG (text-wm-primary/30, 28x28). Blockquote text-[15px] text-wm-ink/80. Avatar: 11x11 rounded-full with 3 rotating tones (bg-gradient-brand / bg-wm-ink / bg-wm-primary), initials bold white. Border-t separator above figcaption.
components.FAQSection: 2-column details/summary (md:grid-cols-2). Item: rounded-xl border bg-wm-surface/30. Summary: text-sm font-semibold with '+' icon (text-xl, group-open:rotate-45 transition). Answer: border-t bg-white p-4 with text-sm/70.
components.ContactForm: Section bg-wm-surface. Two-column: left = contact info list with icon tile (9x9 wm-primary/10) + label + value/clickable link. Right = card rounded-2xl border bg-white p-8. Tab switcher (WhatsApp/Email) inside p-1 border-wm-surface-2 bg-wm-surface pill. Form fields: rounded-xl border bg-wm-surface focus:border-wm-primary focus:bg-white. Submit: rounded-full bg-gradient-brand. Success banner: border-wm-mint/40 bg-wm-mint/10.
components.ClosingCTA: bg-wm-ink text-white with 2 hero-blobs (primary + sky). Centered: h2 with two-tone wordmark (web in white, mula in text-wm-sky), paragraph text-white/75. CTA: rounded-full bg-gradient-brand with shadow-lg shadow-wm-primary/30 + arrow SVG.
components.Footer: white bg, border-t border-wm-surface-2. 4-column (sm:2 md:4): brand+tagline, Layanan links, Company links, Kontak. Google Maps iframe 100% w h-150 rounded-lg. Copyright bar border-t with text-xs text-wm-ink/50.

motion.scroll: Native CSS scroll-behavior: smooth on html.
motion.reveals: None currently — no Framer Motion / Lenis. CSS-only hover transitions.
motion.micro_interactions: hover:-translate-y-1 + shadow on cards. group-hover:scale-105 duration-500 on portfolio images. transition-colors on links. transition on form focus state. group-open:rotate-45 on FAQ +. grid-rows transition on pricing expand.
motion.blur_decor: hero-blob decorative elements (blurred radial orbs) animate visually via blur filter, static positions.

layout.section_padding: py-20 md:py-28 or py-20 md:py-24 — generous vertical rhythm.
layout.section_padding_horizontal: px-6 md:px-8 (or px-5 md:px-8 for 6xl containers).
layout.grid: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 columns responsive. Gap-4 to gap-6. md:col-start-2 for centering last pricing card.

accessibility.icons: All decorative SVGs use aria-hidden or aria-hidden=true. Functional icons paired with text.
accessibility.navigation: Sticky header with z-50. Anchor links (#kontak, #portfolio, #harga, #faq, #layanan, #proses).
accessibility.forms: Required fields, labels above inputs. Tab switcher uses button[aria-expanded] for pricing expand.
accessibility.contrast: text-wm-ink/70 on white for body. text-wm-ink/50 for fine print. text-wm-primary on white for emphasis.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Next.js App Router + Tailwind v4 (@theme in globals.css, no tailwind.config).
Stick to semantic color tokens: text-wm-ink, text-wm-primary, text-wm-sky, text-wm-mint, bg-wm-surface, bg-wm-surface-2, border-wm-surface-2. Never use raw colors in className.
Cards: rounded-2xl border border-wm-surface-2 bg-white with hover lift (-translate-y-1 + shadow).
Buttons: primary = rounded-full (or rounded-xl) bg-wm-primary hover:bg-wm-ink OR bg-gradient-brand. Secondary = border border-wm-surface-2 hover:border-wm-primary.
Section header pattern: eyebrow (text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-wm-primary) + h2 (text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight) centered max-w-2xl/3xl.

Icons: inline SVG with stroke=currentColor, stroke-width 1.8-2.5, round caps/joins. Color via parent text-* class. No emoji icons (Hero already violates this with ✆✉⏱ in ContactForm — replace with SVG).
Spacing rhythm: py-20 md:py-28 for sections, gap-4/5/6 in grids, mt-12 between header and grid.
Hero + ClosingCTA: include hero-blob decorative divs (positioned absolute, blurred, opacity-50) for visual depth.
Contact CTAs use wa.me/6285196399108 and mailto:webmuladigital@gmail.com. Phone number format 0851-9639-9108.
Footer must include Google Maps iframe (embed URL with pb=!1m18...).
Two-tone wordmark: webmula (navbar/footer/testimonials) or web white + mula text-wm-sky on dark ClosingCTA.
Project images: use ProjectImage component to fetch Open Graph screenshot from p.url.
Testimonial avatars cycle through bg-gradient-brand / bg-wm-ink / bg-wm-primary to avoid identical cards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth with hero-blob decorations + subtle shadows, not heavy ones.
Hover states must include a transition (transition-colors, transition-transform, transition-shadow) — never abrupt.
Use generous spacing (py-20+). Section bg alternation (white / surface) creates rhythm without dividers.
Never use 'transition: all'. Specify properties: transition-colors, transition-transform, transition-shadow.
Container is left-aligned (mx-auto) NOT centered via flex/grid on body.
Every interactive element MUST have appropriate aria attributes (aria-label on icon-only links, aria-expanded on toggles, aria-hidden on decorative SVGs).
Never use emoji (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc) for icons. Always inline SVG. (Current ContactForm uses ✆✉⏱ — these are not AI-assistant emojis but still inconsistent; prefer SVG icons matching the rest of the site.)
Maintain color token discipline — never hardcode hex in className. Use wm-* tokens or arbitrary [color] only when introducing a new token to @theme.
